test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north.

Only two people sit to the left of C. Only three people sit between C and G. B sits second to the right of C. Only two people sit between B and A. E sits at some place to the right of F but at some place to the left of D.

How many people sit to the right of C?
solution:
**Given:**

Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row facing north.

Only two people sit to the left of C.

Only three people sit between C and G.

B sits second to the right of C.

Only two people sit between B and A.

E sits somewhere to the right of F but somewhere to the left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c19fc09f583f91478db0410ede219b6e986374ffec7118815815c761e8632191.png] 

Find how many people sit to the right of C.

To the right of C are: E, B, D and G

Total people to the right of C = **4**

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".**
